program.name: Gentle Circuit Long
program.subject: Gentle / low impact
program.blurb: Longer gentle circuits of chair, wall and floor moves, then an easy stretch.
program.about: A longer gentle circuit. Sit-to-stands, wall push-ups, bridges, bird dogs, knee push-ups and marching go round with a rest after each lap, then an easy stretch on the floor. Two circuits alternate. Nothing jumps. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
